gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Beverages' ORDER BY p.price ASC
SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC
SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
